steps.body: PLACEHOLDER: this chapter is still being written, and Snake ToolBox is not going to pretend otherwise. This is Pillar 4, a marquee module. Here you will manage setup and teardown cleanly with the with statement (__enter__ and __exit__, contextlib and @contextmanager, and why files and locks use them). Its boss is build-it-yourself: your own context manager, in both the class form and the @contextmanager form. The full version is on the way. For now this page is an honest signpost of where the road goes next, not the lesson itself.
